payload.reason: The evidence provides specific performance improvements of the proposed similarity measure over BM25, quantified in terms of NDCG and average precision.

claims.text: The proposed similarity measure outperforms BM25 by increasing NDCG@20 by 23%.
The embedding approach boosts the average precision of BM25 by 19% on the TREC 2006 dataset.
The proposed method achieves stronger performance than BM25 on TREC and PubMed datasets.
The semantic measure provides significantly better performance than BM25 in general.
